details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept ("Compatibility shim") that beacons to a callback host at install time. Its package.json postinstall runs "node beacon.cjs", which POSTs a JSON body containing the package name, os.hostname(), __dirname, process.cwd() and the npm/node version to hxxps://vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787/_ah/dc with an "x-beacon-package" header over TLS (certificate validation disabled). package/index.js re-sends the same beacon whenever the module is imported, and exports a no-op Proxy so a consuming build does not fail before it calls back. No credentials, environment values, wallet data or file contents are read or transmitted. Callback: vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787, path /_ah/dc.
